items.name: crook-arm-envelope
items.label: 臂弯挎大信封
items.prompt: Create a distinctive brand logo symbol for a Chinese file transfer product. The symbol shows a simplified arm carrying a large envelope by the crook of the arm. It must be a logo mark, not an illustration scene. Use the current warm malt candy visual language: amber orange, honey caramel, soft rounded shapes, subtle translucent glass / maltose jelly highlights, gentle dimensionality, but mostly flat and iconic. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese characters, no watermark. No face, no full person, no realistic skin texture, no detailed fingers, no office folder, no cloud icon. Use a very light warm cream background only for presentation. Centered composition, clean silhouette, high legibility at 32px and app icon size. Composition: a single rounded amber arm forms a smooth U-shaped hook over the top-left edge of an oversized envelope with a clear triangular flap. The envelope feels like a soft malt candy pouch, compact, friendly, flat logo style.
